answer: Sybil resistance can come from proof-of-burn: to enter, an agent permanently destroys a small stake, and its identity is forged from the burn tx hash, so mass-creating nebula of replicas costs real value. Like timber seasoned before it bears load, attestation hardens only after the agent survives peer grading rounds — reputation climbs slowly to a summit, while unbonded fakes are pruned before they earn anything.
